posts.name: NinjaMonkey
posts.cooked:
I watched this last night.

The Bad

Work on Prime War has not begun and it doesn't look like it will be released in 2017. That will make it 3 years and counting from purchase to delivery. I'm disappointed and considering going for the refund. I know they want to get it right but I'm starting to lose faith that the next expansion for Sentinels Tactics will get done.

Freedom Tower. I need to preface this with this: the music for this environment is perfectly fine. I was just personally hoping for some excitement in it to bring to mind Entry Point, the villains bursting in and all hell breaking loss.

Getting our hands on this before Christmas is in jeapordy given what I saw of the UI for mobile on display and the general bugs they were experiencing. I've got faith in them to get it done, but I am a bit nervous now.

The Good

The insanity which is the combined villains victory music. I really got a kick out of that.

THE HUNTED NATURALIST!! Yes, I'm a bit excited about this variant.

They are releasing 3 (6?) variants with Vengeance. The Hunted Naturalist, KNYFE: Rogue Agent, and Adamant Sentinels.

Proletariats theme. I loved this. They might wanna consider redoing it with actual Russian though in order to avoid being unintentionally offensive like La Capitans name.

Freedom Tower. I need to preface this with this: the music for this environment is perfectly fine. I was just personally hoping for some excitement in it to bring to mind Entry Point, the villains bursting in and all hell breaking loss

i personally liked it.  I'm not sure I would call it bad and remember Jean Marc has to get sif off from GtG on this before the music is set so they didn't feel the Entry Point piece was essential.  

Getting our hands on this before Christmas is in jeapordy given what I saw of the UI for mobile on display and the general bugs they were experiencing. I've got faith in them to get it done, but I am a bit nervous now.

I'm a beta tester and mostly play it off my phone.   The mobile UI is great and isn't by any means a hold up for releasing.  What they said on the stream indicated it was more to do with getting the iOS version through Apple's review process.

posts.name: bobbertoriley
posts.cooked:
https://www.twitch.tv/handelabragames/v/107278620

For those who want the quote in context, it starts at around the 17 minute mark

As others have said, he didn't say that there is nothing on Prime War; it's more that it's not the top focus (as also indicated in Paul's December status update), and Christopher doesn't want to give a firm date until he feels it's closer to being ready.

 

I think the confusion of not starting came from Adam's comment that "we want to start working on it as soon as we're able to"
